title: Tamsin and the Tryouts
author: Freya Amberdale
blurb: Kestrel Crane, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
